displayName: OCI-AI-PD-024: AI — Prompt API Abuse Rate Limiting
description:
Detects excessive API usage that may indicate prompt abuse or scraping of model responses

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

conditions.value: ai — prompt api abuse rate limiting

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_ai_pd_024", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%prompt%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%api%') AND "value" > 0
dataSourceDetails.originalQuery: SELECT "siem_general_ai_pd_024", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%prompt%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%api%') AND "value" > 0
